summary: At step 143, C’s Conflict turn selects an adjacent target and mattackm() reaches its AT_EXPL call to explmm(); JavaScript mattackm() stops at that attack arm. Port the whole mhitm.c explmm() function and wire its existing caller to preserve the elemental explosion and attacker-death order.

source.branch: When mattackm() selects AT_EXPL and distmin(magr, mdef) is at most 1, C calls explmm(); a cancelled aggressor returns M_ATTK_MISS. For AD_FIRE, AD_COLD, and AD_ELEC, explmm() calls mon_explodes(), which rolls the explosion damage and removes the aggressor before explode() affects the defender. Other explosion damage types go through mdamagem(), followed by the attacker-death and lifesaving checks. The assigned C recording reaches the adjacent Flaming Sphere AD_FIRE path through Conflict and fightm().
callers: mhitm.c:mattackm() AT_EXPL arm (497-508), direct caller of explmm()
mhitm.c:fightm() adjacent-target path (121-168), calls mattackm() for the Conflict-selected defender
mon.c:movemon_singlemon() Conflict gate (1305-1318), runtime entry into fightm()
dependencies: mon.c:mondead via mon_explodes before elemental blasts and directly on the non-elemental fallback
DEADMONSTER state and M_ATTK_* result flags for death and lifesaving disposition

evidence: .cache/v21-first-work-queue.json records this v21 session with 25 unmatched screens over 168 steps, manifest SHA-256 d21496df59b943bc811da8b1c1fd73c582b1ee4c6a8154eb9217ae5d539cf4ac, recording SHA-256 feda298380f4512016ea2164d6f9f0b016b7eef6a64a4305e0348e7de6b76e50, and an unsupported M-to-M explosion stop at step 143. challenges/evaluations/20261003183000-v21.json confirms 143/168 matched screens and cursors, 3287/3790 matched RNG calls, and an evaluation at engine commit b0fd76f6091376c07bf54e8d3061aa5a9c9957d0.

.cache/C65-explosion-root-verification.json records the assigned case’s bounded C evidence at step 143: an adjacent Flaming Sphere and eastern goblin enter fightm(); mattackm() selects AT_EXPL, calls explmm(), then mon_explodes() rolls the 4d6 damage and kills the aggressor before explode() affects the goblin. The C evidence rules out a preliminary explmu() damage draw as the cause.

.cache/C65-explosion-crosswalk-v2-root-verification.json confirms the corrected source attribution is the elemental monster-to-monster AT_EXPL/explmm route; its source adjudication passed. The required whole source unit is mhitm.c:explmm(), with its call wired at mattackm()’s existing AT_EXPL arm.

nethack-c/upstream/src/mhitm.c:497-508 calls explmm() only after the AT_EXPL distance check passes. Lines 970-1009 define the whole helper: cancellation exits before effects, elemental attacks call mon_explodes(), other damage types call mdamagem(), then the helper applies attacker death, lifesaving, leash, and tame-monster outcomes.

nethack-c/upstream/src/explode.c:1019-1063 shows mon_explodes() rolling damage and calling mondead() before explode(). At the accepted main commit, js/mhitm.js:798-800 still throws the unsupported M-to-M explosion boundary, and js/mhitm.js has no explmm() implementation. js/explode.js:728-750 already ports mon_explodes(), so the missing source unit and its mattackm() wiring are the actionable scope.

The production entry path is nethack-c/upstream/src/mon.c:1305-1318 movemon_singlemon() -> fightm(), then mhitm.c:fightm():143 -> mattackm(). In JavaScript, js/monmove.js:2693-2697 documents the Conflict fightm() attempt, and js/unported_monster_actions.js:1742-1749 dispatches fightMonster() to mhitm.js:fightm().
